title: Urban Transport Modes and Commuter Satisfaction in Riverton
prompt: The chart below shows the average number of weekday journeys (in thousands) made by four transport modes in the city of Riverton in 2005, 2015 and 2025. The table shows the percentage of commuters using each mode who rated their overall journey experience as 'satisfied' in the same three years. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为雅思学术类写作Task 1练习。所有场景与数据均为模拟，并非官方雅思试卷。请根据图表和表格中的信息，概括主要特征并进行比较。不要表达个人观点或解释原因。字数不少于150词。
